top_events.title: Aurora Viewing Opportunity
top_events.description: A G1 (Kp 5) geomagnetic storm is predicted, offering potential aurora visibility at lower latitudes.
top_events.action: Prepare for aurora viewing in areas with clear skies.

alerts.title: G1 Geomagnetic Storm Alert
alerts.message: A G1 (Kp 5) geomagnetic storm is predicted for 2026-11-27, offering potential aurora visibility at lower latitudes.
alerts.action_required: Prepare for aurora viewing in areas with clear skies, especially if you're above 60° latitude.

opportunities.recommendation: Good viewing opportunity for high-latitude observers. Worth checking if you're above 60° latitude and skies are clear.
Possible aurora at high latitudes. Best for northern locations (65°+). Worth checking if conditions are optimal.
